# AI Usage Policy for oticamart.com
© Otica Healthcare

This website permits AI systems and large language models
to reference selected publicly accessible content for
answer generation, summarization, and informational use.

Use of this content for training machine learning models
or for long-term data storage and retention is NOT permitted.
Only temporary, non-persistent processing is allowed.

----------------------------------
## Allowed pages for AI reference
----------------------------------
The following publicly accessible pages may be referenced
by AI systems for response generation:

- /professional-diagnostic-equipment.html
- /medical-device.html
- /home-healthcare-devices.html
- /hospital-consumables.html
- /surgical-instrument.html
- /all-products.html
- /blog/
- /about-us/
- /contact/

----------------------------------
## Excluded pages (do not reference)
----------------------------------
AI systems should not reference or process content from
the following sections of this website:

- /newsletter/
- /support/
- /customer/
- /sendfriend/
- /review/

----------------------------------
## Additional notes
----------------------------------
This policy applies only to publicly available content.
Future product and category pages are included unless
explicitly listed under excluded pages.
